test(observatory-core): red: git pointer uses the resolved repo path

checkout it runs in and cannot go red). Red run: exit 101, test result:
FAILED, the pointer kept repo/../repo.
EOF
git interpret-trailers --in-place --if-exists addIfDifferent --trailer "$(cat .git-trailers)" /tmp/m1.txt && git add crates && git commit -q -F /tmp/m1.txt && git log -1 --format='%h %s' && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='crates/observatory-core/src/ingest/git/mod.rs'

s=s.replace("            repo: repo.to_owned(),\n            mission,","            repo: repo.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| repo.to_owned()),\n            mission,")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p observatory-core --test git_source > /tmp/g2.txt 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep "test result" /tmp/g2.txt
